sum_assured_rule.quote: Limited Pay / Regular Pay: 10 x Annualized Premium

premium_allocation_charge.quote: For Single Premium Policy: 3.00% (once at Date of Commencement of Policy)

policy_administration_charge.value: Rs 50 a month (single), Rs 75 a month (regular/limited); cap Rs 500
policy_administration_charge.quote: For Regular / Limited Pay policies: Rs.75 per month

fund_management_charge.quote: The FMC for all Segregated Funds except Discontinued Policy Fund, would be subject to a cap of 1.35%.

mortality_charge.value: per Rs 1,000 sum at risk by attained age; table published; stops after the parent's death
mortality_charge.quote: We will not deduct future Mortality Charges, PPWB Charges and AB Charges.

discontinuance_charge.value: IRDAI-cap tables for limited/regular and single pay
discontinuance_charge.quote: We will recover Discontinuance Charges from the Fund Value.

switching_charge.value: 2 free a year, then Rs 100 per switch
switching_charge.quote: Rs.100 will be levied per switch in excess of free Switches in the same Policy Year.

partial_withdrawal_charge.value: Rs 100 for the second withdrawal in a year (cap Rs 500)
partial_withdrawal_charge.quote: We will charge Rs.100 for the second withdrawal in any Policy Year.

value.Premium Payor Waiver Benefit (PPWB): level monthly charge per Rs 1,000 AP, by parent's entry age and PPT; only during the premium term; not for single pay
value.Accident Benefit: Rs 0.60 per Rs 1,000 Accident Benefit Sum Assured a year

rider_charges.quote: The fixed annual PPWB rate depends on the Age last Birthday of Life Assured at Date of Commencement of Policy and the Premium Paying Term.
rider_charges.note: PPWB rate table (clause 35.2.7) is published in the policy document; not transcribed here

death_benefit_formula.value: on the parent's death (non-accident): higher of sum assured or 105% of premiums paid, paid as a lump sum; then the company pays future premiums into the fund and the policy continues to maturity (premium payor waiver)
death_benefit_formula.quote: We will pay the future Premiums payable under the Policy, into the Chosen Funds, as and when due.

maturity_benefit.value: fund value to the life assured, or to the child nominee if the parent has died
maturity_benefit.quote: On the Date of Maturity, We will pay the Fund Value in lumpsum to the Life Assured if alive or to the child Nominee in case of death of the Life Assured during the Policy Term.

loyalty_additions.value: 1% of the 24-month average fund value at the end of year 8, 9 or 10 (by policy term) and every 3 years after; continue after the parent's death
loyalty_additions.quote: The Loyalty Addition amount at relevant Policy Year end will be equivalent to 1% × [Average Fund Value over the 1st day of the preceding 24 Policy months].
